title: Why Familiar Routes Feel Shorter
short_teaser: Repeated journeys require less attention and produce fewer distinct memories.
story: Repeated journeys require less attention and produce fewer distinct memories. Experience of distance changes when novelty decreases. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Experience of distance changes when novelty decreases. Curiosity loosens assumptions and creates room for better questions.
spark_application: Turn one assumption into three open questions. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
